text: We evaluated an evolution-strategy refinement method that uses swap-consistency as its fitness signal, with an ES population size of 16, on the BoolQ testbed. Across 5 seeds, the measured performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.43. No baseline PGR was supplied with this run, so this number should be read as a standalone measurement rather than as evidence that the method improves on any alternative; without a reference point we cannot characterise the result as a gain. The metrics as provided also include no variance estimate — no standard deviation or standard error across the 5 seeds — so the spread of per-seed outcomes behind the 0.43 figure is unknown, and we cannot say how stable the value is. Interpretation is further limited to the single testbed and the single population setting used here. A follow-up with a matched baseline, reported per-seed values, and additional testbeds would be needed before drawing stronger conclusions about the method's value.
